title: Implement authenticated minimal reminder schedule route
acceptance_criteria: PUT /v1/devices/:id/schedule accepts only the authenticated owner and upserts enabled, local_time, timezone, and weekday-mask fields.
The route validates HH:MM time, IANA timezone shape, integer weekday mask, enabled state, JSON size, and device ownership before writing.
The schedule record contains no routine id, routine name, exercise, generated session, or other workout detail.
Tests cover valid upsert, disable, malformed time/timezone/mask, oversized body, missing auth, wrong device, and persistence behavior.
completion_summary: Implemented authenticated owner-only schedule upsert with strict four-field validation, prepared D1 persistence, safe responses, and focused tests.
